messages:
maria: Quick sync — can we finalize the routing policy config for customer_class (free/pro/enterprise) + region overrides + model-variant fallback? We need clear rules for soft vs hard quotas and a predictable API/console UX.

sam: I sketched a minimal config shape below. Wanted something compact we can iterate on. Thoughts?

sam: ```yaml
policy_id: tiered-routing-2026-03
rules:
  - customer_class: free
    priority: low
    region_overrides:
      eu-west-1:
        allowed_models: [gpt-small-q4_8]
    soft_quota: 20000/day
    fallback: true
  - customer_class: pro
    priority: medium
    fallback: prefer-quantized
    soft_quota: 200000/day
  - customer_class: enterprise
    priority: high
    fallback: false
    hard_quota: null
```

jae: Telemetry note — we need per-rule metrics: routed_requests, fallback_count, fallback_latency, cost_estimate. Tag with tenant_id + region + model_variant. Also include a fallback_reason enum (capacity_quota, soft_quota, region_unavailable, degraded).

priya: Rollout UX notes: the console should show an override toggle per-tenant that explicitly opts an enterprise tenant into fallbacks (opt-in only). Also a canary slider (% of traffic) + time window for testing a policy before global rollout.

maria: API semantics: prefer PATCH /v1/routing/policies/{id} with If-Match/ETag for optimistic concurrency. We should also allow a tenant-scoped override endpoint: PATCH /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/routing.

sam: Agreed. Also propose the tenant override object supports pin_model and expires_at. Quick curl example: 
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/tenant_123/policy \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" \
  -H "If-Match: \"etag-42\"" \
  -d '{"override_policy": {"pin_model": "gpt-small-q4_8", "expires_at": "2026-04-01T00:00:00Z"}}'
```

jae: Ops will want a telemetry flag so we can flip verbose sampling for a tenant when investigating fallback spikes. Keep sampling cheap (1-5%) by default.

priya: Enforcement semantics: soft_quota triggers advisory behavior — return X-Quota-Soft: true response header and include a lightweight notice in the streaming response when fallback is used. Hard_quota returns 429 + structured JSON error (code: quota_exceeded).

maria: Also, behavior matrix for tests:
- free: immediate fallback to quantized/smaller variants on soft_quota
- pro: attempt dedicated pool first; on capacity shortfall, fallback to quantized variant (and increment fallback_count)
- enterprise: never fallback unless tenant.override.allow_fallback == true
Can we add an integration test to simulate bursts?

sam: I can own infra tests. I'll add a harness that manipulates quota counters and asserts routing decisions + emitted telemetry.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch/routing-policy-ui -> staging (ci/4567)

maria: Thanks — I'll draft a short RFC with the config schema + API examples and a checklist for console items. tagging for follow-up: @sam @jae @priya :thumbsup:
